era_policy.principle: Group by major content era, not every patch release.
era_policy.note: The user-defined research matrix has 12 eras. The precise mapping of historical releases into those 12 buckets must be documented consistently; Geometry Dash 1.0 is one era, and 2.2 plus its derivative/patch releases is one single era.

object_catalog.requirement: Record the objects available in each era, with object ID, category, first known version, availability evidence, and changes/removal notes.
object_catalog.rule: Do not mark an object as available or validated without evidence; distinguish object existence from whether it can be placed in the editor.

official_robtop.inclusion: All available official RobTop levels, using RobsVault as the collection/reference source, including spin-off levels and beta variants when their identity/version can be established.

rated_online_community.inclusion: Exactly 1,200 rated community levels as the target corpus, separate from all official RobTop levels collected via RobsVault.
rated_online_community.selection_goal: The coolest/most instructive levels: prioritize creativity, gameplay quality, representative techniques, and diversity rather than popularity alone.
rated_online_community.coverage_rule: Track progress toward the 1,200-level target with a 12-era × 10-difficulty × 10-level matrix. If a cell lacks verified rated candidates or usable native level data, record it as a gap rather than silently substituting unrated levels.

difficulty_categories.policy: Use the user's 10 difficulty categories consistently across all 12 eras. Record the exact category taxonomy in a separate mapping before curation; track Demon sub-difficulty and platformer Moon ratings distinctly where relevant.
difficulty_categories.note: The target is 10 categories × 10 rated community levels × 12 eras = 1,200. Do not fabricate categories or claim full coverage before each matrix cell is verified.

analysis_targets: Object vocabulary and object placement patterns
Differences between eras and between official and community design
data_integrity: Store provenance and verification state for every object and level.
Screenshots/videos may aid visual analysis but do not replace native level data for learning object placement.
Do not claim the corpus is complete until coverage and source data have been checked.
status: specification-only; 1,200 rated community levels are a target, not yet collected or analyzed
